UserSpace.title: UserSpace
UserSpace.description: User personalized link groups, links, and settings that are synchronized real-time to Firestore.

ownerId.description: User ID of the workspace owner.

groups.description: Array of link groups containing link items.

settings.description: Application display settings like base theme and new tab preference.
